pr_title: ESQL: support metric tsdb fields while querying index patterns
pr_comments:
The PR does the following:
- adds the missing logic for handling `metric` type of field_caps logic when the same field exists in multiple "places"
- adds a specific exception message (which is different than the one QL is used to) for this type of mapping conflict. The reason is that the field_caps response has an entirely different structure for time series fields mismatches
- adds tests to EQL and SQL to make sure the logic stays untouched there and the special metrics fields handling happens only in ESQL
Hi @astefan, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

issue_context.title: ESQL: using time-series index and non-time-series index results in wrong typed counter field
